name: Tomato Sauce - No Onion No Garlic (320 g)
subtitle: No Onion, No Garlic Tomato Sauce, No refined Sugar, Natural Ingredients

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.shortDesc:
Our pediatricians say: Naturally rich and flavorful that’s what fresh tomatoes bring to the table.
Though technically a fruit, tomatoes are usually enjoyed as a vegetable. Their vibrant red colour comes from lycopene a powerful antioxidant known to protect cells and reduce inflammation. Tomatoes are also a great source of Vitamin C, potassium, folate, and Vitamin K making them as nutritious as they are tasty. Our sauce is made with 75% real, juicy tomato puree to deliver classic taste.

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.shortDesc: Our pediatricians say: Jaggery (or Gud, as it is called in Hindi) is one of the best natural sweeteners. It helps in the regulation of body temperature and detoxifies the body. It also prevents constipation and improves digestion.

fullIngredientsList: Tomato Puree (75%), Jaggery, Water, Natural Vinegar, Salt, Tapioca Starch, Spices and Condiments (Red Chilli Powder, Cinnamon Powder).

description:
Yummy Jain Tomato Sauce No Onion, No Garlic.

Enjoy the rich, classic tomato flavour in this clean, wholesome ketchup.

No refined sugar, no preservatives, no artificial colours or flavours, just real, juicy tomatoes.

Made with 75% real tomato puree, naturally sweetened with jaggery, and blended with a touch of tangy spice for delicious balance.

An antioxidant-rich sauce that makes every snack better and healthier too!

A tangy-sweet blend with a gentle chilli kick. Balanced acidity from vinegar meets the natural sweetness of jaggery, rounded off with a subtle warmth of cinnamon.

Just pour out some tomato sauce and pair it with your kid’s favorite snack from fries to parathas!

We don’t use any preservatives, so make sure to refrigerate after opening and consume within 30 days for the best taste and freshness

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.
